zh: tailnet-preview：每个 PR，一套属于自己的试用环境。
en: tailnet-preview. A private preview environment for every pull request.

zh: 评审代码时，只看 diff 是不够的。你想看到它真正跑起来，带着真实的数据。
en: Reviewing code? The diff isn't enough. You want to see it running, with real data.

zh: 开一个 PR，你自己机器上的 GitHub Actions 就开始工作：构建镜像，复制基线数据，执行这个 PR 的迁移，然后启动。
en: Open a pull request, and GitHub Actions on your own machine gets to work: build the images, copy the baseline's data, run the PR's migrations, and start.

zh: PR 上会出现一条评论，给出一个私有的 HTTPS 地址。点开，就是这个 PR 的完整应用。
en: A comment on the PR gives you a private HTTPS address. Open it, and there's the whole app, for this PR.

zh: 每推送一次，环境就跟着更新。
合并之后，主线的基线环境随之升级，PR 的环境自动删除。
en: Merge, and the baseline on your default branch upgrades. The PR's environment is removed.

zh: 每个 PR 都从基线复制数据，再执行自己的迁移，和真实上线一模一样。
en: Every PR starts from a copy of the baseline's data and runs its own migrations, just like production will.

zh: 只有你 tailnet 里的设备能访问，公网上什么都没有。一台装了 Docker 的 Linux 机器就够了。
en: Only devices in your tailnet can reach it. Nothing on the internet. One Linux box with Docker is all it takes.

zh: 在用 AI 编程助手？贴一段提示词，它就帮你完成接入。
en: Using an AI coding agent? Paste one prompt, and it does the setup.
